analysis: GENOA meQTL variant scoring on frozen SilentMethyl checkpoints
effect_allele_convention: Compare Predicted_Delta_M / Predicted_Delta_Beta against beta_genoa_ref_to_alt. Raw beta_genoa is keyed to the minor allele; the model delta is keyed to hg38 REF->ALT.
effect_scale_caveat: GENOA effect sizes are on a normalized-phenotype scale, not the beta or M scale the model predicts. Spearman rho, direction agreement and AUROC are meaningful; magnitude calibration against GENOA is not.
reporting_guidance: Report the heldout stratum as primary. Never pool the strata. Report CpG-creating/destroying variants separately from the rest.
tissue_caveat: GENOA measured blood; the fusion model's context features are MCF-10A breast tracks. Fusion results here are cross-tissue transfer, not tissue-matched validation. The sequence-only model is tissue-agnostic and is the comparator that makes the fusion result interpretable.
